name: Ecstatic Fury
body:
You choose the way in which you express your inner exuberance.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage, rage or raging song class feature; spirit dance or spiritual invocation class feature.

Benefit(s): You may spend rounds of bloodrage, rage, or raging song as rounds of spirit dance or spiritual invocation, and the other way round. You can choose to use any rage powers you possess with either ability, and your levels in the classes that grant you either ability stack for the purpose of determining the effects of your rage powers.
